## What changed / 改了什麼

## Checklist / 檢查清單

- [ ] `npm run build` passes / 通過
- [ ] `npm test` passes / 通過
- [ ] `npm run links` shows no errors (after a build) / 沒有 error（需先 build）
- [ ] Content rules followed (see CONTRIBUTING.md) / 已遵守內容規則：
  - [ ] A paper is listed only if Wen-Ren Yang (楊文然) is an author / 論文作者含楊文然老師
  - [ ] `verified: true` only with a `source` URL of the publisher page I opened / `verified: true` 一定附上我實際打開的出版社頁面 `source`
  - [ ] PDF only for arXiv / accepted manuscripts (IEEE/IET: DOI only) / PDF 僅限 arXiv 或接受稿
  - [ ] No student email addresses / 沒有學生個人 email
  - [ ] Photos have the person's consent / 照片已取得本人同意
  - [ ] Photos went through `npm run photos` (no GPS / EXIF) / 照片已用 `npm run photos` 處理
  - [ ] Everyone recognisable in the photos agreed to be online / 照片中可辨識的人都已同意上網
  - [ ] No images hot-linked from other websites (files are in `public/`) / 圖片放在 `public/`，沒有外連他站圖片
  - [ ] No unpublished details, datasets or model configs / 沒有未發表細節、資料集或模型設定
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes / 外觀變更已附截圖
